set.body: PRD V-4/A-10 and the 13-row machine-readable baseline remain binding. Reconciled 2026-09-17: 26 classified cases,4 equivalent,8 justified divergences,14 unresolved gaps. Pinned reference families cover exhaustive cosine/failure behavior, supplied coordinate maps, entropy/map arithmetic, phase repetition, fixed-feature versus normalized-map fitting, and fixation admission; temporal/multiscale eyes4s-only independent oracles remain distinct. Every remaining case needs public eyesim calls at the exact source pin and consumed dependency lock, independent expected behavior, offline JVM/JS checks and PARITY findings. No aggregate percentage excuses a gap; no fixture-only closure without a runnable public route. Run tools/r-parity/check_baseline.py with --eyesim, --mote and --run-regeneration.
